updates.title_zh: 花旗与Coinbase扩大7×24小时法币通道，覆盖逾1.5亿用户
updates.title_en: Citi and Coinbase Expand 24/7 Fiat Access for 150M-Plus Users
updates.what_changed_zh: 花旗与Coinbase将全天候法币通道扩展至合计超过1.5亿用户群。
updates.what_changed_en: Citi and Coinbase extend 24/7 fiat access to a combined user base of more than 150 million.

updates.current_state_en: Citi and Coinbase are expanding their partnership to give businesses infrastructure connecting traditional fiat payments with stablecoins, extending round-the-clock fiat access to a combined user base of more than 150 million.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
花旗与Coinbase正在扩大合作，为企业提供连接传统法币支付与稳定币的基础设施，并将全天候法币通道扩展至合计超过1.5亿的用户群。相关报道将这一企业级稳定币支付合作描述为一项计划中的合作。

拓宽银行与交易所之间的支付通道，使用户能够全天候进行法币出入金，把受监管的银行结算直接连接到加密货币交易场所。

报道将该举措定性为一项计划中的企业级稳定币支付合作，并以合计逾1.5亿的用户群为规模定位。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Citi and Coinbase are expanding their partnership to give businesses infrastructure that connects traditional fiat payments with stablecoins, extending round-the-clock fiat access to a combined user base of more than 150 million. Reports describe the corporate stablecoin payments effort as a planned collaboration.

Broadening bank-to-exchange payment rails gives users round-the-clock on-ramp and off-ramp access, linking regulated banking settlement directly to crypto trading venues.

Reports characterize the initiative as a planned corporate stablecoin payments collaboration, framed around a combined user base of more than 150 million.
updates.background_zh: 法币“入金通道”和“出金通道”是法币与加密资产相互兑换的服务，充当传统金融体系与数字资产市场之间的桥梁。面向企业的稳定币支付基础设施也在扩张，一份检索资料称企业对企业（B2B）稳定币支付同比增长733%，达到2260亿美元。
updates.background_en: Fiat on-ramps and off-ramps are the services that convert government-issued currency into crypto and back, acting as the bridge between the traditional financial system and digital-asset markets. Stablecoin payment infrastructure for businesses is also expanding, with one search reference citing B2B stablecoin payments rising 733% year over year to $226 billion.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该合作聚焦于法币出入金环节，银行结算的速度与可用性决定了资金在银行账户与加密交易场所之间的流转效率。因此，7×24小时通道的扩展可能影响Coinbase交易资产的流动性状况，以及用于企业支付的稳定币资金流。
updates.market_impact_en: The tie-up targets the fiat on/off-ramp layer, where banking settlement speed and availability determine how quickly capital can move between bank accounts and crypto venues. Expanded 24/7 rails could therefore affect liquidity conditions for Coinbase-traded assets and the stablecoin flows used in corporate payments.
